answer: The report is consolidated using the financial-statement consolidation scope and generally covers all consolidated Volkswagen Group companies. Environmental data is gathered primarily for consolidated production companies, additionally including controlled but unconsolidated Volkswagen Sarajevo and Audi Formula Racing; selected environmental disclosures include Chinese joint ventures under operational control. Governance data follows the consolidated group with stated topic-specific adjustments. Both upstream and downstream value chains are considered in impact, risk and opportunity assessment and are described as part of the Group's complex, partly vertically integrated value chain.

normalized_value.basis: consolidated basis tied to consolidated financial statements
normalized_value.environmental_adjustment: primarily consolidated production companies plus specified controlled unconsolidated entities and selected operational-control entities
normalized_value.governance_adjustment: topic-specific adjustments stated in frozen page

evidence.quote: Volkswagen AG’s sustainability report was prepared on a consolidated basis.
data is gathered primarily for the consolidated production companies
Both the upstream and downstream value chain is taken into account when assessing impacts, risks and opportunities
